name: runner
description: Claude Runner: a small endless-runner side pane that plays while Claude works. It opens when a turn starts, follows the session's state (working, waiting for a tool, thinking, completed, error) and stops when Claude answers. /runner opens or closes it by hand.

autoOpen.title: Open when Claude starts working
autoOpen.description: Open the Claude Runner pane on its own when a turn starts. The terminal only places a pane a plugin opens unasked when it is wide enough (144 columns, 110 once you have opened it yourself); /runner opens it at any width. Closing the pane yourself turns this off until you open it again with /runner.

closeOnComplete.title: Close when Claude answers
closeOnComplete.description: Close the pane 5 seconds after Claude answers, when it opened on its own at the start of that turn; it opens again with the next turn. A pane you opened with /runner stays, and so does one showing an error.

milestones.title: Milestone messages
milestones.description: Show a message in the game when Claude's turn runs long: at 30 seconds, 1, 2 and 5 minutes.
